description: This file defines the `HttpProtocolException` class, a custom exception extending `ServiceInvocationException` for HTTP protocol errors within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes multiple constructors for different error scenarios, static methods for transforming exceptions, and assertions specific to HTTP protocol error codes.

classes.name: HttpProtocolException
classes.description: Custom exception for HTTP protocol adapter errors, extending ServiceInvocationException and providing methods for exception transformation and validation.
